label: Tip 01
title: The 24-hour rule for items over 200k VND
teaser: Why do you always want to check out right away late at night?
back: The dopamine rush fades sharply after 24 hours. Add the item to your cart but don't pay yet. If it still feels important the next morning and doesn't affect your essential costs, then consider buying it.

label: Tip 02
title: Smart grocery shopping & deal hunting
teaser: How to cook healthy meals in your room and save up to 40% on food.
back: 1. Always eat before going to the supermarket so you don't overbuy.
2. Keep a fixed shopping list on your phone.
3. Shop after 7 PM to pick up vegetables and fresh food marked down 30-50% for same-day use.

label: Tip 03
title: The virtual envelope strategy in your banking app
teaser: Stop living "like a king at the start of the month and on instant noodles at the end".
back: Open 2 separate bank accounts: Account A receives your money and covers fixed costs (rent, food); Account B holds only that week's spending money. When Account B is empty, you stop going out, and your food money stays safe!
